title: Acervator - The Accumulation Trading Platform
author: Ekthelius
selftext:
Hello All,

My new custom Governance Execution Platform is now available for public testing and feedback:

[https://github.com/Acervator-LLC/ACERVATOR](https://github.com/Acervator-LLC/ACERVATOR)

It is a unique and powerful platform but is still in active development with plenty of polish still being needed but the core trading engine works and I have been actively testing it four months.

There is plenty information on the GitHub and under 'docs'.  Look forward to any input or testing results. 

  
Thanks,  
Ekthelius / Tony
